item.title: Ohtani jersey from WBC goes for record $1.5M
item.description: The jersey two-way Japanese star Shohei Ohtani wore during the country's 13-0 win over Chinese Taipei in the World Baseball Classic on March 6 sold for $1,500,010 via MLB Auctions on Sunday night -- the most ever paid for a Ohtani jersey at auction.

item.title: Panthers' Greer suspended 3 games for shove
item.description: Panthers forward A.J. Greer has been suspended three games for shoving Calgary Flames forward Connor Zary into the boards from behind.

item.title: Shakira concert in Doha, Abu Dhabi festival postponed as conflict rages
item.description: Abu Dhabi’s Offlimits Music Festival, which was due to be headlined by Shakira and the Jonas Brothers, has been postponed until November, according to UAE ticketing platform Platinumlist

item.title: Zolqadr appointed Iran’s new security chief
item.description: According to Qatar-based broadcaster Al Jazeera, Iran has named a new secretary for its top security body. State media confirmed that Mohammad Baqer Zolqadr has been entrusted with this key position
